output.summary: The 30% decline is largely not attributable to the music director. Peer orchestras that did not move fell 25-35% (median 29%), though more gradually. Our single-ticket sales fell 45% in the move year versus a 9% peer median, and the cathedral near the rail station sells far better, so the venue move hit casual buyers. Core subscribers renew at a steady 85%, which rules out core defection. Concerts with major post-1945 works sell the same as those without. Marketing is untested because no attribution data was collected. Recommend a segmented analysis before the contract vote, the cathedral dates and a shuttle pilot. Do not decline renewal on revenue grounds or cut contemporary repertoire.
